name: 81212 · Canon City, CO
findings: ZIP 81212 (Canon City) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81212 (Canon City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 81212 (Canon City) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
